title: Temperature 0 + seed, yet run 1 differs from runs 2+: llama-server's prompt cache (cached_tokens) changes the batch shape
user_report: Our regression test sends the same request twice at temperature 0 with a fixed seed and compares the replies. The first reply after a new prompt never matches the later ones; from the second call on they match each other. Is the 4-bit quant nondeterministic on GPU, or is the seed being ignored?

environment.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4 GB, all layers offloaded
